text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One fine weekend while on a shopping trip, I see two familiar faces…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: It's okay, right? Just a little won't hurt, will it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: This… is not right… You cannot… get away with such…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Oh, heya! Perfect timing. I was just telling McQueen about my go-to cake shop.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You must help me, I beg of you! Nature is trying to seduce me with sweet temptations!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Seduce?! I just was caught up in singing the praises of my favorite place, is all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: In fact, they're apparently running an all-you-can-eat event today! Good reason to pop in, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And, well, you're always working so hard. A little cake won't hurt.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: B-but… it's all-you-can-eat! How can I possibly resist those cakes?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Look at that frosting! It's like snowdrops blooming in a field covered in the softest powder snow!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: The fruits are the jewels that adorn it, wrapped in a blanket of golden syrup that is the breath of civilization…

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Gulp… What. A. Wordsmith.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Listening to you is making me hungry! Dang… So this is sweets seduction!

text_block_list.name: The Two
text_block_list.text: Gasp!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-well, indulging in just one delicious treat should be luxury enough for us, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Quite right…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they enjoy the cakes in moderation.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah… this is all our efforts bearing fruit. Yeah… That's it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I too have made up my mind. To refuse such an opportunity would be disrespectful to the cakes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Are you ready, Nature? Let's dig in with the same spirit we would if we were sprinting down the slopes of Yodo!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's get to it!

text_block_list.name: Nature and McQueen
text_block_list.text: Mmmmm! It's sooooo good!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, they enjoy the cakes to their hearts' content.
